title: First-Screen Review Gate — README/dashboard 改前主公预览机制
description:
EPIC-173 — 借鉴 loopx AGENTS.md First-Screen Review Gate: README/dashboard 改前主公预览机制.

**Context**: 主公 2026-08-05 Phase 5 D 拍板. loopx AGENTS.md 规定: 'Before committing, pushing, or self-merging changes that alter the first viewport, hero block, primary CTA, or opening navigation of README, hosted frontstage, showcase index pages... show the user a preview first and wait for approval.'

**设计 (跟 EPIC-163 check-private-context 1:1)**:
1. **scripts/check-first-screen.sh** — scanner 检测 first-screen 改动 (README.md, README.en.md, web/index.html, web/showcase/index.html, hosted frontstage 等)
2. **trigger**: 当 staged diff 命中 first-screen paths → 提示主公预览, 等批准
3. **pre-commit hook 集成**: 检查 staged first-screen files → 触发 master approval 流程
4. **ticket.json schema**: 改 first-screen 加 `verification.first_screen_preview` + `verification.first_screen_approved_by` 字段
5. **0 增 Rule, 0 改 source code** (仅新 scripts + docs + ticket schema)

**跟 EPIC-163 check-private-context 1:1 协同** (immutable check script + pre-commit 集成)
**跟 EPIC-069-D check-claim-evidence 1:1 协同** (boundary check)
**跟 EPIC-074 4-branch flow 联合** (first-screen PR 必走 4-PR)
acceptance: AC1: scripts/check-first-screen.sh scanner 检测 5 first-screen path (README.md + README.en.md + web/index.html + web/showcase/index.html + hosted frontstage)
AC3: pre-commit hook 集成 check-first-screen 阶段 (staged first-screen files 检测)
AC4: ticket.json schema 加 first_screen_preview + first_screen_approved_by 字段 (跟 EPIC-163 verification 1:1)
AC9: 0 改 source code, 0 增 Rule, 0 增 immutable script
deliverables: scripts/hooks/pre-commit 改 (加 check-first-screen 阶段)
node/src/schema/ticket-schema.ts 改 (加 first_screen 字段)
created_by: master (主公 2026-08-05 Phase 5 D 拍板: loopx First-Screen Review Gate 借鉴)
